The '''Republic Infantry''' was a division in the [[Republic Army|Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="TOR" /> The Army enlisted more new recruits per year than most of the other branches of the armed forces combined, with the overwhelming majority serving in infantry units. Infantry units did the bulk of the fighting on the war's front lines. More than 80 percent of engagements against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] involved some degree of infantry combat.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> During the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], the Republic Infantry fought on battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Notable units included the [[Second Infantry|Second]], [[Fourth Infantry|Fourth]], [[Thirty-eighth Infantry|Thirty-eighth]], [[Eighty-first Infantry|Eighty-first]], [[Eighty-sixth Infantry|86th]], and [[301st Infantry|301st Infantries]] were among the various units within the Republic Infantry.<ref name="TOR" />
